rows.why: In the front view A's forelegs pinch in where they meet the bulging chest, while B's forelegs come down as full, clean columns and show a clearer elbow from the side. / In the front view B's upper legs are fuller with a visible knee where they leave the chest; A's legs are narrow straight tubes.

The two ankylosaurs look the same in every view; only a few edge pixels differ. / A has a deeper chest-belly fold and a slight waist pinch, B a straighter trunk with a crisper but shallower fold; legs and head match, so neither is better.

The two beetles look the same; the legs differ by a pixel at most. / B's beetle legs have a slightly thicker upper segment and a visible joint where the lower segment starts; A's legs are plain tapered tubes (subtle).

Seen from the top, A's mid-body swells wider (53 vs 50 cm) and steps in sharply at both ends; B tapers more evenly. / B's neck narrows just below the head in the front and head views, so the head reads as distinct; A's neck is an even tube up to the jaw (subtle).

A's forearms balloon out past a pinched elbow into clubs, while B's arms taper evenly and its hips and thighs are fuller. / B's forearms swell at the elbow and the thigh reads as its own mass in the side view; A's arms and legs are uniform tubes (subtle).

A's knees bulge out like balls below thin thighs, while B's fuller thighs taper smoothly into the knee. / B's knees bulge as knees with a calf taper below them in the front and 3/4 views; A's legs are smooth straight tubes.
The two small lizards look the same in every view. / Limbs, head and body are practically identical at this size; B's upper arm is at most marginally fuller.

The two tusked boars look the same; only the outline shifts by a pixel. / A's belly sags low between the legs and swallows the elbows; B's belly line is tucked, so the forelegs and hind legs read as separate limbs.

B's upper legs have muscle mass and taper down to slim shins, while A's legs are thin tubes of even width. / A shows a pale pinched crease where the thighs meet the belly; B's thighs join cleanly, with fuller upper legs and a defined knee.
The two scorpions look the same in every view. / B's walking legs show segment joints (a knee bulge mid-leg); A's legs are smooth bent tubes.

A's body bulges slightly wider behind the neck (47 vs 45 cm); otherwise the two sea serpents match and neither is better. / In the front view B has a clearer neck waist under the head and a fuller body below it; A reads as a straighter column (subtle).

B's thigh is a full drumstick that tapers into the knee, while A's thigh is thinner and flatter. / A has a pale pinched crease where the thigh meets the belly; B's thigh blends in as a muscular drumstick with a clear knee.
The two bears match in legs, torso and head. / B's foreleg shows an upper arm and elbow separating from the chest under a tucked belly; A's belly hangs low over the forelegs, so they read as stumps.

B's hind thigh shows creases and faceted folds down its length and above the knee, while A's hind leg is smooth with a clean knee. / A's foreleg is thin, with a pale blob at the shoulder join and a crease in the hind thigh; B's foreleg is fuller, with a clear elbow and a smooth hind thigh.
The two salamanders look the same; B's mid-body is a hair fuller at most. / Limbs, feet and head match; B's belly hangs a few pixels deeper, which makes neither better.

The two ants look the same; only the leg edges move by a pixel. / B's ant legs show a knuckle bulge at the segment joint in the top view and slightly thicker femurs; A's legs are plain tapered tubes (subtle).
The two goblins look the same; B's thigh and neck are only a hair fuller. / Legs, hips, head and arms match; only faint shading differs at the knee.

The two rearing snakes have the same spindle-shaped raised body and the same head. / The front views match; in the head close-up B's neck flares wider below the jaw while A's tapers, and neither is clearly better.

The two rhinos look the same; B's chest is only fractionally fuller. / A has a small dip behind the shoulder hump and B a smoother back with slightly fuller forelegs; the outlines are within a few pixels.

A has a lumpy hind knee, and in the front view its forelegs kink and pinch under the chest; B's legs are clean columns with a smooth taper. / B has a deeper chest and fuller shoulders and upper legs that blend into the body; A's legs are thinner where they join.
